annotations.title: 株式会社インテルゲート｜intelgate,Inc.

content.text:
**“IntelGate” can refer to a few different things, depending on context:**

1. **A U.S. political/intelligence controversy** — often called **“Intelgate”** — involving allegations that U.S. CENTCOM intelligence reports on ISIS/ISIL and the wars in Iraq and Syria were manipulated or “softened” around 2015. ([military-history.fandom.com](https://military-history.fandom.com/wiki/Intelgate?utm_source=openai))

2. **A company name** — **Intelgate, Inc.** is also the name of a Japanese IT/web-services company. Its site says the name combines “Intel” from the Italian word for internet and “Gate” as an “entrance” to internet business support. ([intelgate.co.jp](https://intelgate.co.jp/?utm_source=openai))

3. **Other similarly named businesses/products** — e.g., software/digital-solutions companies using “INTELGATE,” or possible confusion with “InvGate,” an IT service/asset management platform. ([cy.linkedin.com](https://cy.linkedin.com/company/intelgate?utm_source=openai))

If you saw “IntelGate” in a political/news context, it most likely means the **CENTCOM intelligence-manipulation scandal**. If you saw it in a tech/business context, it may be a **company or product name**.
